Podcasts live on their listeners. A boost sends sats — bitcoin over Lightning — straight to the people behind a show, with a message, split the way the show sets it. Streaming sends a few sats per minute while you listen, only if you switch it on. Sovereigncast shows also let you bring episodes out sooner and vote on topics.
